newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: JG Summit eyes Victorias buy-in.
newsitem.headline: JG Summit eyes Victorias buy-in.

text.p: JG Summit Holdings Inc is interested to buy into the financially-troubled Victorias Milling Corp, JG Summit chairman John Gokongwei said.
Gokongwei, speaking to reporters on Wednesday night after the company's annual shareholders meeting, said JG Summit would like to take a majority stake in Victorias.
JG Summit operates three sugar mills in the country. It also has interests in property development, banking, hotel management, food manufacturing, telecommunications, airlines and petrochemicals.
Gokongwei said the Philippine sugar business still has bright prospects despite the current slump in the industry due to the surge of cheaper sugar imports.
Victorias and its trading arm asked a payment moratorium for their combined six billion pesos debt from creditors recently due to the local sugar crisis.
